tagline: Post Zoom meeting action items to ClickUp tasks automatically
metaTitle: Zoom + ClickUp Integration: Meeting Action Items to Tasks
metaDescription: Leave every Zoom call with tasks assigned. GAIA turns meeting action items into ClickUp tasks and posts the summary to ClickUp docs. See the setup steps.
intro:
Zoom meetings produce action items, but those commitments only move work forward if they're captured in the project management tool your team actually uses. For teams on ClickUp, that means someone has to manually translate meeting notes into tasks — a step that often gets deprioritized.

GAIA eliminates that step by parsing meeting summaries and creating tasks automatically. Each action item gets the right assignee, due date, and list placement so your ClickUp workspace reflects every commitment made on the call.

useCases.title: Create ClickUp tasks from Zoom meeting action items
useCases.description: GAIA processes the meeting summary and creates a task for each action item. Assignees and due dates from the meeting are applied, and a link to the Zoom recording is attached.

useCases.title: Post meeting summaries to ClickUp docs
useCases.description: After a call, GAIA creates a Doc with the full meeting summary, attendee list, and decisions. Teams have a searchable record of every meeting in the same tool they use for tasks.

useCases.title: Route action items to the right list
useCases.description: GAIA maps action items to lists based on keywords or assignees in the meeting notes. Engineering tasks go to the dev list; marketing tasks go to the campaigns list automatically.

useCases.title: Update task status based on Zoom follow-up calls
useCases.description: When a follow-up call closes out an open task, GAIA marks it complete and posts a note with the call summary. Task history stays connected to the conversations that drove it.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and ClickUp to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and ClickUp workspace. Map meeting series to the spaces, folders, and lists where tasks should be created.

howItWorks.step: Configure task creation and routing rules
howItWorks.description: Define how GAIA infers assignees, due dates, and priority from meeting context. Set keyword-based routing rules to place tasks in the correct list automatically.

howItWorks.step: GAIA turns every call into tracked tasks
howItWorks.description: After each meeting, GAIA creates tasks with full context. Your team leaves every call with a complete, tracked to-do list ready to execute.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create tasks in different ClickUp spaces for different meeting types?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure separate space and list mappings for each recurring meeting or meeting type. Each meeting series routes to its own destination.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support the subtask feature?
faqs.answer: Yes. If an action item in the meeting summary has sub-steps, GAIA can create a parent task with subtasks. You can enable or disable subtask creation in the integration settings.

faqs.question: How does GAIA handle Zoom meetings where no clear action items are identified?
faqs.answer: If no action items are found, GAIA creates a summary-only Doc rather than tasks. You receive a notification so you can manually add tasks if the meeting contained implicit commitments.
